round: V27: retrain stage 3 (>=6144, the 12288 sprint) with the V23 stage-2 method
status: frozen before any training-pool generation, training or evaluation
motivation: V26 concluded the search settings are exhausted and recommended improving the evaluation tables. Stage 3 is still the V21 table (uniform first-6144 starts, two-move behaviour policy only); V23 raised stage 2 by +5.1 pp with on-policy starts and a strong sparring player.
machine: Mac mini, Apple M5 Pro (6 super + 12 performance cores), 64 GB
rules: official-modern (RULES.md); THREES_BONUS_RULE unset; 12288 ends the game

baseModel.note: CUR = current website model; its stage 3 is V21 S3. Both arms start from this stage 3; stages 0-2 are never changed.

trainingPool.policy: website default AI (V23, depth 5, cutoff 0.01, leaf clamp 0, no cap) from standard openings to the first 6144 (training/v26-late-cutoff/pool.cpp); terminal states excluded; all kept states used
trainingPool.onpolicy: each first-6144 state continued with the same website search (unsent deck reshuffled with 27110001+index) to 12288 or death; the state is recorded every 25 moves from move 0 while alive with max card exactly 6144 (training/v27-stage3/sample.cpp). Training starts are drawn uniformly from these.
trainingPool.disjointness: opening seeds 27100001-27102000 are used by no evaluation pool

training.method: V23 method on stage 3: TD(lambda=.5) five-step truncated score return, multiplicity-normalised update, learning rates .02/.008/.003 (V21 stage 3) stepping down at 50% and 85% of the move budget; episodes to 12288 (terminal 0) or death
training.strongPlayer: complete 3-ply expectimax, no cutoff, clamped leaves, using the model being trained
training.deviationFromV23: V23 set the strong share as 25% of CPU time and stopped by CPU seconds; both depend on the machine. V27 uses move counts instead so that training is deterministic given the seed: an episode is strong when strong moves so far < 0.003 x all moves so far. Pilot (timing only, V21 train-6144.txt, 3M moves, seed 99270001): strong share 0.002/0.005/0.01 of moves took 19/36/53% of CPU; a strong move costs ~0.27 ms vs ~2.4 us, so 0.003 is about 25% of CPU. Pilot models were discarded unevaluated.
training.budgetNote: A (2e9 moves) is about 7200 CPU s on this machine; B is 4x A. For scale, V21 S3 made 5.4e8 updates and V23 arm A 8.3e8.

screen.arms: A, B and CUR (each = CUR with that arm's stage 3; CUR unchanged), website search depth 5 / cutoff 0.01 / clamp, to 12288 or death
screen.rule: winner = arm with more 12288s; tie -> higher total scoreGained; exact tie -> A. No test.
screen.reproductionCheck: CUR on this pool with these seeds is the V26 arm B run; its non-timing fields are compared with games-B.jsonl as a descriptive cross-machine determinism check. It does not affect any decision.
screen.independence: the V26 pool (openings 26100001-26103000) is disjoint from all V27 training data; V26 examined only search settings, never these tables

confirmPool.policy: same as the training first-6144 generation; terminal states excluded; sorted by opening seed, the first 2048 used; if fewer than 2048, add 400-seed blocks until enough
confirmPool.freeze: confirm6144.txt SHA-256 recorded in eval-pool-manifest.json before any continuation

confirm.compare: screen winner vs CUR, same search as the screen, same pool state and rollout seed per pair
confirm.primary: reach 12288: two-sided exact McNemar, alpha 0.05 (single primary)
confirm.interim: after the first 1024 pairs: stop and conclude only if p < 0.001 (Haybittle-Peto); otherwise continue to 2048 with no other look
secondary: scoreGained paired mean difference, normal-approximation 95% CI
native CPU ms per move (16 concurrent processes; not a web latency)
confirm.power: V26: CUR reached 12288 from first 6144 in 8.7%, with few pairs succeeding in both arms. For +3 pp (8.7% -> 11.7%) about 21% of pairs are discordant; at 2048 pairs the approximate power is 0.85, at 1024 about 0.55.

adoption: Adopt the winner's stage 3 into a new website model (V23 stages 0-2 + winner stage 3) only if (1) the confirmation primary is significant in its favour (interim stop or final p<0.05), (2) its scoreGained difference vs CUR is not significantly negative, (3) on the first 128 6144-phase states of training/v25-adaptive-cutoff/browser/states.txt, untimed JS and native C++ choose the same direction for every state and the browser completes depth 5 on >=99% of timed measurements with P95 < 160 ms, and (4) all repository tests pass. Otherwise the website model is unchanged.
compile: from the repository root: c++ -std=c++17 -O3 SOURCE -o training/v27-stage3/bin/NAME (no -march), NAME in pool (training/v26-late-cutoff/pool.cpp), sample, train, compose (training/v27-stage3/*.cpp), snap (training/v21-late-train/snap.cpp). Apple ld embeds the output path, so binary hashes match only for these paths and this compiler.
workersNote: 16 concurrent simulation processes; the two training runs use one core each and may overlap pool generation
